_: The bar's Lisää sheet, item by item. `sections` opens it and closes it again; this one goes through it. Vuosilakana and Asetukset are screens on both sides. Harjoituspaikat is a screen on the reference and nothing here — the sheet closes and the app lands back where it started — and it is pressed last because the reference does not come back from it.

steps.name: Harjoituspaikat
steps.why: LAST, because the reference opens a page the bar cannot be reached from again; here the sheet closes and nothing opens
